newsitem.title: USA: Edison Int'l reports S. California outage.
newsitem.headline: Edison Int'l reports S. California outage.

text.p: Southern California Edison, a unit of Edison International, said about 8,600 customers in the San Fernando area lost electric power because of a substation fire.

The company said in a statement that the fire took place about 12:20 pm in a substation in San Fernando. SCE crews are working to re-route power to customers and repair damages. Service will be restored as quickly as possible, the statement said. The fire in the unmanned substation apparently began when a squirrel crawled onto a circuit breaker and caused an electric arc, or "flashover."
Firefighters extinguished the blaze within 10 minutes, but the flames had already damaged equipment that supplies power to San Fernando.
